Emma: PR #8427 is blocked — need design reference + architecture review before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8427
Emma: RFC: https://redwood.company/rfcs/2026-06-fallback-routing
Emma: trying to ship this Friday EOD if arch sign-off is quick. Can someone take a look?
Ryan: looking now. can you paste a 1-line SLO impact summary? pinging @Devon
Devon: I can take a look after lunch. does this change routing/fallback behavior? if yes we need an explicit canary/rollback plan
Emma: short summary: adds conditional fallback to `model-compact` when latency > 500ms; stress tests show p50 +2ms, p95 +5ms. Canary: 1% for 24h -> 10% for 6h. rollback: revert route config and set traffic to 0%.
Emma: canary snippet:
```
canary: {"initial":0.01, "duration":"24h", "step":0.10, "monitor":"latency,p95"}
```
Devon: please attach the RFC to the PR and add a clear rollback step in the PR body. tag me when done (@Devon). also add a note about KV cache keying change if any
Ryan: :thumbsup: i'll do an arch read-through this afternoon. if i can't finish before EOD, i'm +1 to delay to Monday — don't want weekend oncall churn
Patrick: I can do docs pass (README + changelog) but not arch lgtm. agree with delaying if arch can't sign off.
ops-oncall: heads up — weekend merges increase oncall load. prefer Monday unless this is urgent
deploy-bot: PR 8427 flagged `needs-arch`. CI green. unit/integration tests passing.
Emma: thanks — updating PR with RFC link and rollback steps now. will @Ryan and @Devon when done.
